10666|43217733.name: Gordo
10666|43217733.text: Us is busy with important things!

10666|5f4181c7.name: Gordo
10666|5f4181c7.text: Oh yeah. Us gots it right here.

1496|54d7bdcd.name: Deathguard Dillinger
1496|54d7bdcd.text: Take it, then. It seems Zygand is too busy for the agonizing trip here to retrieve it himself.

1500|2af9e51a.name: Coleman Farthing
1500|2af9e51a.text:
I hope you're well, all things considered.

Sit for a spell, and hear my tale.  It's a tragedy, of course, but one I hope will end in revenge!

1515|778f03ac.name: Executor Zygand
1515|778f03ac.text: The Scarlet Crusade is encroaching on our homeland. The foolish zealots do not realize that the loyal servants of The Dark Lady shall see to their demise.

1518|173903a2.name: Apothecary Johaan
1518|173903a2.text: The Dark Lady has put forth the challenge.  It is up to us to meet it.

244808|3f8410df.name: Aramis Hammerhand
244808|3f8410df.text: Welcome back to the light, friend. Do you require training?

246143|0c0fbd1e.name: Frightened Paladin
246143|0c0fbd1e.text:
No! No, no, no! This can't be. I'd rather be dead than Forsaken! 

<The Frightened $C raises her weapon, preparing to attack!>

246152|8754b3a4.name: Shari Stilwell
246152|8754b3a4.text: The light is a beacon that shines for all. What can I do for you, $c?

249363|595011e8.name: Yala Windwatcher
249363|595011e8.text:
The Wind Spirits have left us. 

Now, only mindless echoes remain. Be wary, however. These winds are neither kind, nor gentle.

251001|379c835f.name: Deathguard Kristof
251001|379c835f.text:
Please do see that he reads it at once. I fear our Scourge problem has only just begun.

Come see me again in due time. I believe I have nearly uncovered something I could use a willing blade to help with.

251361|d8b5b5c2.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
251361|d8b5b5c2.text: What do you need of me, child of Zephras?

251371|645a98fa.name: Falorne Fallwind
251371|645a98fa.text:
Zephras is in great danger. The elemental wind spirits that brought us here to Skywall so many thousands of years ago have abandoned us, leaving us vulnerable in this unstable realm. Our once-robust society spanned multiple island sanctuaries in our corner of Skywall, but now we are not even sure if any other shen'dorei remain outside of this small island.

Things are dire, but the High Order is committed to rising to this challenge.

251371|7b3bdf9a.name: Falorne Fallwind
251371|7b3bdf9a.text:
Magic can accomplish almost anything, but stagnation and inaction have caused us to lose so much of ourselves in the thousands of years since we left Kalimdor. The High Order seeks to reclaim the Highborne heritage that we've left behind and become the masters of our own destiny once again.

The Windshapers think we are simply reckless and arrogant. Hypocrisy at its finest, if you ask me. The Windshapers will entertain no ideas but their own when it comes to this crisis. Who, I wonder, is truly arrogant?

251371|c4bcd3c9.name: Falorne Fallwind
251371|c4bcd3c9.text: Greetings to you, fellow High Order initiate.

251379|e154a23f.name: Dorii Brightwhisper
251379|e154a23f.text: The followers of the old Highborne ways have never been more hungry to gain knowledge and reclaim what we've lost. If you would seek to wield the power of the arcane and have the aptitude, I can help you take your next steps.

257554|41088e5c.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
257554|41088e5c.text: <The gaze of the ranger standing before you is fixed on the enormous anchor pylon in the distance.>

263113|81449513.name: Myriaal Mistwake
263113|81449513.text: It can get boring up here, you know. I can only annoy that stuffy wretch Halaan so much before even that gets old.

265944|0c543544.name: William Pickman
265944|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

265944|b48f927f.name: William Pickman
265944|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

5819|88989ac8.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|88989ac8.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces are made and repaired here locally, though some are scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

365-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-progress.text: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents.  Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?
365-progress.title: Fields of Grief

367-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-progress.text: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
367-progress.title: A New Plague

375-progress.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-progress.text: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, $N?
375-progress.title: The Chill of Death

376-progress.name: Novice Elreth
376-progress.text: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
376-progress.title: The Damned

381-progress.name: Executor Arren
381-progress.text: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.
381-progress.title: The Scarlet Crusade

3902-progress.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
3902-progress.title: Scavenging Deathknell

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

407-progress.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-progress.text:
Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .
407-progress.title: Fields of Grief

427-progress.name: Executor Zygand
427-progress.text: If you wish to prove your worth to The Dark Lady, slay 10 Scarlet Warriors, $c.
427-progress.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

5481-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-progress.text: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
5481-progress.title: Gordo's Task

79095-complete.name: Owen Thadd
79095-complete.text:
Thank you, $N. Our knowledge expands through your efforts.

If you discover more magical works that might benefit the library, please bring them to me.
79095-complete.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer

79095-progress.name: Owen Thadd
79095-progress.text: Have you brought something to add to our collection?
79095-progress.title: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer

86784-accept.name: Deathguard Bartholomew
86784-accept.text:
My associate Eleanor Shackleton prides herself on traveling the wilds, surviving against weather and monsters. She is currently camped not far from here, in the hills to the west, and I remember a piece of advice that she once gave me: "When you think you have enough firewood, gather five times more."

If you have some spare time, you could collect some wood in this basket and take it to her camp. I'm sure she could give you a few tips about the existence of a traveling adventurer.
86784-accept.title: Sticks and Bones

86784-complete.name: Eleanor Shackleton
86784-complete.text:
Extra firewood? That is always welcome. It will keep these old bones warm through the cold nights of the Glades.

I have a sling for collecting wood myself, so you might as well hang onto that basket.
86784-complete.title: Sticks and Bones

90902-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
90902-accept.text:
I am proud to welcome another newly risen $c to our ranks. As you begin to reconnect with the light you may notice that certain abilities that were once second nature to you may cause you considerable pain to use now, particularly those involving channeling the light to heal yourself or others. 

The only way around this problem is--unfortunately--to go through it. Like any other muscle that has atrophied, you must push through the pain and exercise the flesh for it to return to full function.
90902-accept.title: Rediscovering the Light

90902-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
90902-complete.text:
Pain is nothing new to those who have endured death, and as such the Forsaken are particularly hardy to it. Pain has a purifying property as well that you should embrace as a badge of honor and evidence that you are, in fact, still a servant of the light despite your new circumstances. 

Be well and walk in the light once more, $c.
90902-complete.title: Rediscovering the Light

91208-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91208-accept.text:
Not all of our fellow Paladins who rise again are quick to acclimate to our new reality. Some struggle to reconcile that they are now, in a way, the very thing they spent their lives fighting against.

These individuals often simply need a kind gesture and a sympathetic ear. Unfortunately, many others are quick to turn violent. Find the frightened $c who fled into the hills directly west of this chapel. Extend a hand in friendship. Lead them back into the light if you can.
91208-accept.title: Coming to Terms

91208-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91208-complete.text:
Tragically, more than a few of our brothers and sisters succumb to a similar madness after being risen. As precious as every Forsaken soul is, sometimes the best we can do is grant those that cannot acclimate a clean end.

I will say a prayer to the light for her. Thank you for doing what must be done, $N.
91208-complete.title: Coming to Terms

91209-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
91209-accept.text:
Lordaeron may not be what it used to be, but our home still needs protection from all manner of threats and it's time for you to go out and face the world. Your next stop should be the town of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. Go and meet with Shari Stilwell there. She can see to your continued training. 

One last bit of advice before you go--take extra care as a $c traveling through Forsaken lands. There are many in the Dark Lady's service who distrust us and our proximity to the light.
91209-accept.title: Continue Your Training

91209-complete.name: Shari Stilwell
91209-complete.text:
Welcome aboard, $c. It's always encouraging to see more of our number roaming these lands. There are many here in Brill in need of assistance from adventurers such as yourself. Seek employment and grow stronger in the light. Return to me whenever you need training. 

When you've proven yourself to myself and the people of Brill, I will provide guidance for the next leg of your journey.

Go with the light, $c.
91209-complete.title: Continue Your Training

91282-accept.name: Shari Stilwell
91282-accept.text:
It is encouraging to see my newly risen brothers and sisters thrive as you have. It is only through community and shared faith that we can truly realize our full potential however, and to that end we've begun to form a new $c order right here in Tirisfal. 

If you wish to learn more, you should visit our monastery on the edge of the Whispering Woods. It is called Bandarion Keep. It's on the bluffs just northwest of the Solliden Farmstead, and should be hard to miss.
91282-accept.title: A Second Home

92461-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92461-complete.text:
Thank you for your service to Zephras, young $c.

The vuldren are typically quite docile, but the animals that call Zephras home can sense when the magic on the winds is out of balance, which can lead to dangerous and unpredictable behavior if left unchecked.
92461-complete.title: Harmony in Balance

92462-accept.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92462-accept.text:
One of our rangers recently reported an infestation of cirrusflies here in Thendal Grove. 

Cirrusflies can be dangerous if the swarm is allowed to grow too large, so please head to the eastern end of the Grove and exterminate as many as you can.
92462-accept.title: Infestation Investigation

92462-complete.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92462-complete.text: Judging by the amount of bug entrails covering you, this must be quite the infestation.
92462-complete.title: Infestation Investigation

92463-accept.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92463-accept.text:
If the forest is as thick with these insects as it sounds, simply killing the workers won't be enough.

Go deeper into the forest and find the queen. She'll be close to the hive and surrounded by bigger and more aggressive soldiers, so be careful.

Put her down and return here when it's done. That'll be one less problem to think about around here.
92463-accept.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92463-complete.name: Elatrell Featherlight
92463-complete.text: Excellent work, $N. You'd make a fine ranger if this whole "adventurer" thing doesn't work out for you.
92463-complete.title: The Cirrusfly Queen

92464-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92464-accept.text:
Ever since our elemental benefactors left us, it seems that we are simply moving from one unrest to another. The problem we face now is that the manifestations of the winds near the standing stones to the northeast are agitated.

Not truly self-aware like the sentient wind spirits that once lived here, these simple sprites respond in kind to forces, emotions, and intentions of the creatures around them. 

My apprentice Yala Windwatcher went to observe them. Seek her out and discover what she's learned.
92464-accept.title: Elemental Unrest

92464-complete.name: Yala Windwatcher
92464-complete.text: Rorian sent you? Good. I could use your aid.
92464-complete.title: Elemental Unrest

92465-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-accept.text:
The Al'Aketh cult is a blight upon this island. These cultists are surely the ones responsible for agitating the simple wind sprites that reside here and turning them violent.

Regrettably, we'll need to disperse these roiling winds here before they harm someone. We also need to send a clear message to the cult that they are not welcome in the grove.

Will you lend me your aid, $c?
92465-accept.title: Agitators

92465-complete.name: Yala Windwatcher
92465-complete.text: It pains me to shed shen'dorei blood here in the grove, but we do what we must.
92465-complete.title: Agitators

92469-accept.name: Yala Windwatcher
92469-accept.text:
You've done enough here, $c. I'll stay and clean up any stragglers down there.

Head back to the Village and tell Rorian about the cult's presence. He will not be pleased.
92469-accept.title: Return to Rorian

92469-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92469-complete.text:
This is most troubling, but unfortunately unsurprising. We've been aware of the cult's movements for some time, but we've been content to watch from afar. Their agitation of the wind spirits near the standing stones is a clear escalation on their part.

You've performed a difficult but necessary service for Thendal Grove, $N. Thank you.
92469-complete.title: Return to Rorian

92470-accept.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92470-accept.text:
Rorian informed you that I've been watching you. I now offer you a test of resolve. However, be warned--it will send you into great danger.

Go to the caves to the west. Thin out the ursera's numbers there, and find their matriarch, one the rangers call "Urs'anah". Put her down and bring me proof of her demise. Once you have done that, you will have taken an important step on your path.
92470-accept.title: Foul Matriarch

92471-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92471-accept.text:
You may not realize this but everything you've done has been a trial of sorts. A test for what is to come for you. It's a big island out there, and Zephras needs spirited young adventurers such as yourself if we are to survive the trials our people face.

The one called Aetheen of the Gales is one of the leaders of our people here on Zephras Isle, and she has been watching you. She has a task that you must complete. Speak with her to learn more.
92471-accept.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92471-complete.name: Aetheen of the Gales
92471-complete.text:
Rorian has told me much of you. I am likely unknown to you, but I am a member of the Council of Elders here on Zephras Isle. I've come to read the flow of the winds here in Thendal Grove. I'm also here to assess young shen'dorei such as yourself that are coming of age.

So tell me, are you ready to take your next step? Are you ready to serve Zephras Isle?
92471-complete.title: Aetheen of the Gales

92473-accept.name: Valreaa Valewind
92473-accept.text:
The ursera den to the southwest is rapidly becoming a problem. Just last week the rangers had to kill an adolescent ursera who wandered too close to the village and attempted to attack a boy playing near the base of the elder tree in the center of the village.

We were fortunate that the boy escaped with his life. Hunger and desperation makes these beasts too dangerous to be left unchecked. Go south and put the scrawniest among the ursera down. Bring me their claws as proof when it is done.
92473-accept.title: Aggressive Encroachment

92474-accept.name: Myriaal Mistwake
92474-accept.text:
Well hello there, $N! Want to play a game?

All you've got to do is step up on that ledge... then jump! Use your innate ability to walk on the air to slow your fall and see how far forward you can float.

The rules are made up and the points don't matter, but you get bonus points if you can land right in front of Rorian the Dayseeker and startle him! He won't like it but I'll certainly get a good laugh if you can get him all worked up! Hah!
92474-accept.title: Falling With Style

92474-complete.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92474-complete.text:
How many times do I need to tell Myriaal not to encourage others to make reckless usage of our $r gifts!

That being said, I suppose that a little bit of practice in the relative safety of the village is... acceptable.

In the future I'd simply suggest you to use your ability judiciously. You do not want to exhaust your magic thoughtlessly and then not be able to use it when you truly need it.
92474-complete.title: Falling With Style

92481-accept.name: Rorian the Dayseeker
92481-accept.text: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident $c trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
92481-accept.title: A Student of the Arcane

92481-complete.name: Dorii Brightwhisper
92481-complete.text:
Let me have a look at you. Yes, I believe you will make a fine young $c. The power of the arcane has waned amongst our people, but there are those who would seek to rediscover much of what we've lost in the millennia we've spent here amongst the clouds. I am sure that you will lead the charge in this never ending search for arcane knowledge, and ultimately make us proud.

Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
92481-complete.title: A Student of the Arcane

92481-progress.name: Dorii Brightwhisper
92481-progress.text: Greetings, $N. I'm pleased to have the privilege of furthering your magical studies.
92481-progress.title: A Student of the Arcane

92597-accept.name: Falorne Fallwind
92597-accept.text:
Here in the elemental plane, we derive much of our arcane strength from leylines that still run through the ground under our feet. Of late, these leylines have begun to pierce the surface, giving us more direct and powerful access to these latent arcane energies.

Go to the standing stones to the northeast. There is a leyline there. Tap into your birthright and draw in its energy.
92597-accept.title: Reading the Leylines

92597-complete.name: Falorne Fallwind
92597-complete.text:
Do you feel it? Yes? Good! You have taken your first steps. You'll find that with your abilities, you will be able to tap into latent magical energy in many locations. Doing so will provide a myriad of benefits, some profound, others more subtle. You won't know until you tap into them, but that's the best part of the gift... making the unknown known.

If we are to survive these dire times, we must be unwavering in our search for knowledge... and power.
92597-complete.title: Reading the Leylines

93552-accept.name: Dalia the Collector
93552-accept.text:
Windstones are a critical resource on Zephras Isle as they contain the raw, concentrated energy of the winds themselves. The wind elementals who used to live here on Zephras with us vanished a number of years ago, and since then, the magic that sustains this island is slowly fading. Not without limitations, the windstones are still a reliable energy source, and are incredibly valuable to us.

You'll find raw windstones scattered around the grove. Think you can help me harvest them?
93552-accept.title: Harvesting Windstones

93552-complete.name: Dalia the Collector
93552-complete.text:
Thank you very much for these. As elves we all have a deep connection to magic and these windstones are becoming more and more precious as the magic imbued into this island by the great anchor pylons continues to fade. 

Windstones aren't the only beneficial thing you can harvest from the land. Please, take one of these manuals.
93552-complete.title: Harvesting Windstones

94414-accept.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
94414-accept.text:
Greetings, young $N. I oftentimes come here to look upon the ancient anchor pylon. Gifts from the spirits of the winds, they bind and sustain our island. Of late however, their magic has grown unstable and inconsistent.

They suffer no distress I can see. Their splendor has not changed.

If you'd like, I can lend you my gift to look upon them yourself.
94414-accept.title: The Anchors of Zephras

94414-complete.name: Halaan Hawk-Eye
94414-complete.text: Thank you for taking a moment to share this with me. I will continue to watch over the grove, and ponder on the state of our homeland.
94414-complete.title: The Anchors of Zephras

95314-accept.name: Carolai Anise
95314-accept.text:
Before the Scourge invasion, the reclusive village of Shadowvale was known for its Whispering Elixir. Distilled from herbs found only in Tyr's Fall, the elixir was sought by apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners alike even after being banned in the city.

I've had requests from a number of buyers eager to get their hands on some elixir. Travel to the ruins of Shadowvale deep in the Whispering Forest to the west. I'm prepared to offer significant compensation if you can recover some bottles for me.
95314-accept.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

96607-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
96607-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. This is good. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

You'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful in this line of work. Not sure how your outdoor skills are but I can probably teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire and get comfortable. I'll walk you through it.
96607-accept.title: The Great Outdoors

96607-complete.name: Eleanor Shackleton
96607-complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill from the trainers in the village nearby. They will also teach you how to create a camp fixture suitable to your new profession.
96607-complete.title: The Great Outdoors

96656-accept.name: Executor Arren
96656-accept.text:
$N, you have proven yourself trustworthy in your endeavors against the Scarlet Crusade so far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Brill. Go and see what she's doing.
96656-accept.title: The Adventurer

96656-complete.name: Eleanor Shackleton
96656-complete.text:
I'm not affiliated with the Scarlet Crusade, if you couldn't tell. I'm just an adventurer stopping by before my next venture into the wilderness.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
96656-complete.title: The Adventurer

96658-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
96658-accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.
96658-accept.title: Camping 101: Cooking

96658-complete.name: William Pickman
96658-complete.text:
With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.

Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.

You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
96658-complete.title: Camping 101: Cooking

97558-accept.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-accept.text:
One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an $r heal itself?

Well, it doesn't.

Ours is a cursed life, $N. We must take from the living to further our own existence.

When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!

Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
97558-accept.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97952-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
97952-accept.text:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97952-accept.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97955-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
97955-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97955-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97955-complete.name: Nurse Neela
97955-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own First Aid Kit. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97955-complete.title: Camping 101: First Aid

97956-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
97956-accept.text:
You might not think so, but your skill as a fisherman can actually come in handy at camp.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Fish Bowl for your camp. You can use this fixture to help provide a bit of joy to yourself and your fellow adventurers. A happy adventurer is a strong adventurer and I'm sure your combat capabilities will reflect that.
97956-accept.title: Camping 101: Fishing

97959-accept.name: Eleanor Shackleton
97959-accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.
97959-accept.title: Camping 101: Mining

98389-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98389-accept.text:
If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.

This we have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.

Then they will see our nature.
98389-accept.title: A Light in the Darkness

98389-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98389-complete.text:
May this help Executor Arren and so many others see our true nature. Much like in our past lives, we live to serve our people--to protect them with the gifts the Light provides us.

They will see in time that we are just as valuable to the Dark Lady's plans as any other.

Light be with you.
98389-complete.title: A Light in the Darkness

98601-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
98601-accept.text:
While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine it's of some importance to a $c like yourself.

Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
98601-accept.title: A Difficult Path

98601-complete.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98601-complete.text: Your training can now begin in earnest, $c. I see great promise in you, but take care not to turn away from the light, even for a moment. Embrace the pain it will cause you. That pain is a crucible, and you will emerge from it stronger than you ever were in your previous life.
98601-complete.title: A Difficult Path

99134-accept.name: Executor Zygand
99134-accept.text:
You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.

As a reward for your relative lack of incompetence, you shall punish those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.

Swiftly now--$N, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
99134-accept.title: Discipline

99134-complete.name: Executor Zygand
99134-complete.text:
There are precious few delights afforded to us in death. Thankfully, pain is chief among them.

You please me this day, and therefore you please the Dark Lady. Perhaps you can be of further use.
99134-complete.title: Discipline

99141-accept.name: Executor Zygand
99141-accept.text:
Make no mistake, $c--the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.

Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.

You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
99141-accept.title: Patience

99141-complete.name: Executor Zygand
99141-complete.text:
I should have known better than to think an abomination could write anything of use. Let us keep that lapse of judgment between us.

You have pleased me, and therefore pleased the Dark Lady. Perhaps there is hope for you.
99141-complete.title: Patience

99141-progress.name: Executor Zygand
99141-progress.text: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
99141-progress.title: Patience
